label: L (BLIND: unseen data, every question type, current system; run once)
description: SET L: the first results on unseen data. 30 questions in 10 stories. Status: BLIND. Written after sets A to K were spent and before any change to the system. Run once on the current system with summaries on, and, as a pre-registered second column, with SUMMARIES=0 on the same stored data. Predictions: docs/predictions/set_L.md. Mixes every question type at a natural rate: direct facts, changes, past questions, episodes and plans, indirect questions, and abstain or third-person traps. All people, places and foods are new.
